This directly targets the selected kernel's 49.42% DRAM utilization and 0.4 long-scoreboard stall ratio.

Consider processing a small block of output channels per CTA only if register growth stays controlled.
Expose a single wrapper entrypoint in `cuda_cpp` while keeping launch selection inside the extension.
